en.name: Get Well
en.description: Churn up a magical breeze to heal self and allies. Targeted monsters will be pushed away.
en.command: {KeyBind:Dash} + {KeyBind:GrabOrGuard} Can be added to a Quick Slot Can be used via a Quick Slot with your sol
tooltip: Recovers 700 HP per 1 ticks for 3 ticks (Applied to self and allies)
Applies effect to max 10 allies
